title: Correlation Clustering of Organoid Images: Code
description:
Code for the paper Correlation Clustering of Organoid Images (GCPR 2024). It contains (i) twin neural networks (TNI, TNH) that estimate the probability that two organoid images show organoids of the same class, (ii) a partial quadratic assignment problem (PQAP) formulation for the same task, and (iii) solvers for the resulting correlation clustering problems.

The image data is available separately at https://doi.org/10.25532/OPARA-598; the script download_data.sh downloads it.
